scripts.dev: npm run build -w @cea/shared && concurrently -n web,api -c auto "npm run dev -w @cea/web" "npm run dev -w @cea/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cea/shared && npm run build -w @cea/web && npm run build -w @cea/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cea/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cea/web && npm run typecheck -w @cea/api
scripts.quality: npm run integration:check && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
